listings.description: Human8e Ltd | Applied cryptographer, protocol review | REMOTE (worldwide) | Contract, fixed fee We're an early-stage UK company building a mobile application, funded by its founder (just me), which is why the scope below is deliberately narrow. I'm looking for an applied cryptographer to review a protocol specification before it ships. It is small and specific: three messages, two parties, signature-based, using hardware-backed keys on both iOS and Android. It uses standard primitives only (ECDSA over P-256, SHA-256) and invents no new cryptography; the question is how they are combined. The specification is written and frozen, with test vectors and the generator that produces them. What I want is a competent second opinion on whether it is sound: six specific questions answered in writing. Not an open-ended audit or a penetration test. The person I'm looking for has either published on protocol security or reviews protocols professionally; being good with crypto libraries isn't quite the same thing. One piece of contract work, not a role. Under a short mutual NDA. Email clive@human8e.com by Sunday 4 October with a short summary of the protocol analysis you've done, and I'll send scope, timing and what I'd need from you.

The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. listings.title: Data selection and quality evaluation for biological foundation models
listings.description:
At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

We advance the state of the art in molecular design by training large-scale foundation models that enable cutting-edge generative approaches. Those models depend on rich, high-quality experimental data that captures biological function. Progress requires not only building better models, but also designing better experiments, understanding measurement systems, and generating datasets that faithfully represent underlying biology.

You will collaborate closely with biologists and machine learning researchers to design, analyze, and improve the experiments that power our models. You will help determine what data should be generated, how experiments should be structured, how measurement artifacts can be identified, and how biological insights can be translated into scalable data generation strategies.

Your Mission, should you choose to accept it

  • Embody our vision of an antedisciplinary environment and embrace learning about areas outside of your traditional area of expertise
  • Develop statistical and computational approaches to characterize assay quality, reproducibility, and sources of experimental variation
  • Identify and investigate sources of bias and measurement artifacts in biological datasets
  • Design and analyze large-scale biological experiments that generate training and evaluation data for machine learning models
  • Partner with experimental scientists to improve assay design, controls, and data collection strategies
  • Collaborate with machine learning researchers to understand how experimental design decisions impact model training and evaluation
  • Analyze, visualize, and communicate findings to support decision-making across scientific and engineering teams

listings.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Hannover
listings.description: Salonkee kommt nach Hannover und sucht die erste Person im Vertrieb. Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und repräsentierst Salonkee als hauptsächliche Ansprechperson. Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Outbound-Sales inkl. Kaltakquise. Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung – du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort. Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert und organisiert. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet dich bei uns Klare Entwicklungschancen : Nächste S

listings.title: Senior Expansion Manager:in (m/w/d) für Standortakquise in München
listings.description: Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen! Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Süd rund um München verstärken. Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. Als Pionier im Bereich der Schnellladeinfrastruktur haben wir es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 ein europaweites Netz von über 1.000 Schnellladestationen aufzubauen. Du arbeitest in einer innovativen und schnell wachsenden Branche, in der sich Markt, Technologie und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Dabei verbindest du dein Immobilien- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit einem konkreten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität. Deine Arbeit hat sichtbare Ergebnisse: Aus deinen Analysen, Gesprächen und Verhandlungen entstehen neue Schnellladestationen, die täglich von Menschen in ganz Deutschland und Europa genutzt werden. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit unseren Teams aus Architektur, Legal, Construction und Operations zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Lösungen, teilt Wissen und bringt neue Ideen in die Umsetzung. Ausser

listings.title: Agentic Software Engineer (f/m/d)
listings.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world's leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you're hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. The Impact You Will Have: As an Agentic Software Engineer on the Platform Architecture squad, you will build the multi-agent systems that autonomously refactor and modernize Sonar's own codebase — starting with one of our biggest technical bets: unifying SonarQube Cloud (SQC) and SonarQube Server

listings.title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
listings.description: About us At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road. From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show. Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities. Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead! Your Mission As Head of Supply Chain , you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will: Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price. Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations. Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation. listings.title: Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
listings.description: Deine Herausforderungen bei uns... Technik-Hero: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unserer Abteilungen bei komplexen technischen Anfragen der Kunden zu unseren Systemen und Anwendungen. Linux-Versteher: Du bewegst dich sicher auf der Linux-Konsole, um Logfiles zu analysieren (Apache, Nginx, Mail-Logs) und Ursachen für Störungen direkt zu identifizieren. Besser als das FBI: Du überwachst per Monitoring unsere Serverlandschaft und schreitest schnell ein, wenn es zu internen Störungen der Infrastruktur kommt. Beratung: Du erklärst auch komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und gibst Tipps zur Optimierung der Kundenserver. Schnittstelle: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Kundenbetreuung und unserem Projektmanagement zusammen, wenn es um globale Optimierungen geht, die du aus dem Support-Alltag ableitest. Dieses Skillset bringst Du mit! Hosting-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits im Webhosting-Umfeld gearbeitet und kennst die typischen "Pain Points". Fundierte Linux-Kenntnisse: Du fühlst Dich auf der Kommandozeile zu Hause und weißt, wie man Kernel-Parameter und Dienste tuned. Maildienste und Datenbanken: Du bist ein Experte beim Finden und Lösen von Mailproblemen (Postfix/Dovecot) und kannst sicher MySQL und MariaDB administrieren! Virtualisierung und Monitoring: Systeme, um aus einem Server mehrerer virtuelle Server zu machen sind Dir nicht fremd und du kannst diese auch noch überwachen (z.B. ICINGA2) Lösungsorientierung: Du denkst nicht in Problemen, sondern in stabilen, skalierbaren Lösungen. Kommunikationstalent und Sprache: Du hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt, bleibst auch bei kniffligen Fällen geduldig und formulierst präzise Antworten. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und kannst technische Dokumentationen auf Englisch verstehen. Und darum wirst Du bei uns happy! Ein Unternehmen mit einem harmonischen Klima und einer Kultur, die von Verantwortung & Vertrauen, Hilfsbereitschaft & Wertschätzung, Zufriedenheit & Freude geprägt ist Ein sicherer und abwechslungsreicher Arbei

listings.title: Data Collection Engineer ADAS (m/w/d)
listings.description: Wir über uns Wir gehören nicht zu den Größten aber zu den Besten! Die CEIS GmbH bietet als zuverlässiger Entwicklungspartner branchenübergreifende Ingenieur- und IT-Dienstleistungen an. Die Kernkompetenzen unserer Engineering Services liegen auf Homologation, Fahrzeug-Management und umfassende Komplettlösungen rund ums Fahrzeug. Profitieren Sie von der Sicherheit eines inhabergeführten Unternehmens und von einem Netzwerk, das über die Jahre durch Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Vertrauen gewachsen ist. Teilen Sie mit uns die Leidenschaft für das Automobil und lassen Sie sich von unseren Werten überzeugen. Gemeinsam mit uns in die Zukunft! Wir freuen uns auf Sie! Zum Einsatz bei einem unserer Kunden suchen wir zum 01.11.2026 einen Data Collection Engineer ADAS (m/w/d) mit folgenden Spezifikationen: Ihre Aufgaben Umgang mit Daten, einschließlich Upload, Validierung der hochgeladenen Daten sowie Korrektur und Anpassung bis zur Übergabe der fertigen Daten. Dazu gehören unter anderem Ground-Truth (GT)-, Kamera- und weitere Sensordaten. Betreuung und Koordination von Test-Track-Aktivitäten sowie Pflege des aktuellen Aufgabenstatus nach definierten Prozessen und in den entsprechenden Tools, z. B. Jira oder Monday. listings.title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
listings.description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. listings.description:
Über 130.000 Fahrzeuge im Jahr, quer durch Europa. Jede Route, jeder Stellplatz und jeder Transportpartner ist eine Entscheidung mit Preisschild. In deinem Praktikum lernst du, wie diese Entscheidungen mit Daten vorbereitet werden, und bringst deine eigenen Analysen ein.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. The Role

We are seeking a Precompute Platform Lead to own and scale Addepar's precompute layer — the platform that pre-calculates financial analytics and transparently integrates precomputed and real-time results, delivering step-change improvements in query latency and concurrency for enterprise-scale wealth management firms.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

listings.title: Data selection and quality evaluation for biological foundation models
listings.description:
At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

We advance the state of the art in molecular design by training large-scale foundation models that enable cutting-edge generative approaches. Those models depend on rich, high-quality experimental data that captures biological function. Progress requires not only building better models, but also designing better experiments, understanding measurement systems, and generating datasets that faithfully represent underlying biology.

You will collaborate closely with biologists and machine learning researchers to design, analyze, and improve the experiments that power our models. You will help determine what data should be generated, how experiments should be structured, how measurement artifacts can be identified, and how biological insights can be translated into scalable data generation strategies.

Your Mission, should you choose to accept it

  • Embody our vision of an antedisciplinary environment and embrace learning about areas outside of your traditional area of expertise
  • Develop statistical and computational approaches to characterize assay quality, reproducibility, and sources of experimental variation
  • Identify and investigate sources of bias and measurement artifacts in biological datasets
  • Design and analyze large-scale biological experiments that generate training and evaluation data for machine learning models
  • Partner with experimental scientists to improve assay design, controls, and data collection strategies
  • Collaborate with machine learning researchers to understand how experimental design decisions impact model training and evaluation
  • Analyze, visualize, and communicate findings to support decision-making across scientific and engineering teams

You will collaborate closely with AI researchers and biologists to rigorously characterize the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models and their applications. You will identify valuable datasets, develop meaningful evaluations, investigate model behavior, and generate insights that guide model development, data strategy, and experimental priorities across the company.

  • Investigate how model performance changes with data quantity, data quality, dataset composition, and training methodology

  • Design and execute rigorous experiments to understand the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models
  • Identify sources of potential artifacts, bias, and noise in biological datasets

listings.title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
listings.description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You own the code that runs in the factory. What We're Looking For 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable. B-rep and Mesh Depth . You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged. Kernel Fluency . Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes. Technical Excellence . Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python

We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). listings.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
listings.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability. What you'll do Architecture Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks Implement component tests

listings.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EM

About the Role As an Electrical Engineer , your main role will be to design and develop electronic boards and embedded systems (SoM) for UAVs (e.g., Flight Controllers, Companion Computers, Electronic Speed Controllers). Responsibilities High-performance embedded system design : Define the architecture and design the physical and electrical integration of complex systems based on processors, fast memory (DDR, Flash), and peripherals (e.g. embedded computers/calculators, sensors, video processing…). Advanced schematic and routing design : Design and develop electronic schematics, and perform board placement/routing to meet design specifications, managing fast signal constraints. Physical integration : Collaborate with the Mechanical Department to ensure the seamless physical integration of the boards into the final product. Sensor integration : Work closely with the GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) Department to ensure accurate and effective sensor integration. Electromagnetic compatibility : Address and resolve EMC challenges while ensuring signal integrity. Troubleshooting : Identify and resolve issues in electrical and electronic boards through effective troubleshooting. Testing and Validation : Conduct testing, integration, and performance validation of electronic boards to meet operational and design requirements. Candidate Requirements Educational Background : Master’s degree in Electrical Engine
